formulas.formula: mode A (percent-per-day): lateFee = invoiceAmount * (lateFeeRatePct / 100) * daysLate; totalDue = invoiceAmount + lateFee. mode B (flat + daily): lateFee = flatFee + (dailyFee * daysLate); totalDue = invoiceAmount + lateFee.
formulas.name: Late Payment Fee
formulas.notes: Late-fee enforceability and caps vary by jurisdiction and contract. Tool is informational math only; the rate must come from the user's own contract terms.

formulas.formula: rushFee = baseProjectPrice * (rushPct / 100); rushTotal = baseProjectPrice + rushFee.
formulas.name: Rush Fee
formulas.notes: No market-standard rush percentage exists in this registry; the percentage is the user's own pricing policy.

variables.rushPct: USER ASSUMPTION (user's own rush pricing policy), 0-100

formulas.formula: billableDays = workingDaysPerYear - nonBillableDays; dayRate = (annualIncomeTarget + annualBusinessExpenses) / billableDays; hourlyEquivalent = dayRate / hoursPerDay (user input). Shoot variant adds perShootCosts (assistant, gear) into annualBusinessExpenses or per-shoot cost basis as user chooses.
formulas.name: Freelance / Shoot Day Rate
formulas.notes: Pure cost-recovery math. Does not account for market demand or utilization risk.
userAssumptions: workingDaysPerYear default is a convenience starting point, user-adjustable; all other inputs are user figures

formulas.formula: floorRate = monthlyBusinessCosts / billableHoursPerMonth; walkAwayRate = floorRate * (1 + bufferPct / 100).
formulas.name: Walk-Away Rate
formulas.notes: The walk-away rate is a personal business floor derived from the user's own costs; it is not a market rate.

variables.bufferPct: USER ASSUMPTION (desired margin above cost floor), 0-100

formulas.formula: killFee = contractValue * (killPctForStage / 100), where killPctForStage is the user-entered percentage for the selected project stage (not-started / in-progress / near-complete). clientRefund (if prepaid) = amountPaid - killFee.
formulas.name: Kill Fee
formulas.notes: No standard kill-fee percentage is asserted. Percentages must come from the user's contract; the tool must not suggest defaults presented as standard.

variables.killPctForStage: USER INPUT from user's own contract terms, 0-100

formulas.formula: mode A (percent): exclusivityFee = baseDealFee * (exclusivityPct / 100) * exclusivityMonths; totalDealValue = baseDealFee + exclusivityFee. mode B (flat): exclusivityFee = flatExclusivityFee (user input); totalDealValue = baseDealFee + exclusivityFee.
formulas.name: Exclusivity Fee
formulas.notes: Exclusivity pricing is negotiated per deal; no standard percentage exists in this registry.

formulas.formula: mode A (percent): monthlyFee = baseContentFee * (whitelistPctPerMonth / 100); whitelistingFeeTotal = monthlyFee * whitelistMonths; totalDealValue = baseContentFee + whitelistingFeeTotal. mode B (flat): monthlyFee = flatMonthlyFee (user input); whitelistingFeeTotal = monthlyFee * whitelistMonths.
formulas.name: Whitelisting Fee
formulas.notes: Whitelisting (paid amplification rights) pricing is negotiated per deal; no standard rate asserted.

formulas.formula: usageFee = baseCreativeFee * durationMultiplier * territoryMultiplier * mediaChannelMultiplier; totalWithBase = baseCreativeFee + usageFee + (baseCreativeFee * exclusivityAddOnPct / 100). All multipliers are user inputs.
formulas.name: Usage Rights Fee
formulas.notes: No industry-standard usage multipliers are encoded. The tool multiplies the user's own factors only.

formulas.formula: mode A (single rate): estimatedAnnualTax = annualNetProfitEstimate * (effectiveTaxRatePct / 100); estimatedQuarterlyPayment = estimatedAnnualTax / 4. mode B (split rates): estimatedAnnualTax = annualNetProfitEstimate * ((incomeTaxRatePct + selfEmploymentTaxRatePct) / 100); estimatedQuarterlyPayment = estimatedAnnualTax / 4.
formulas.name: Quarterly Tax Estimate (Freelancers)
formulas.notes: CRITICAL — NO HARDCODED TAX RATES: no defaults, no placeholders resembling rates, no country presets. The tool multiplies user profit by a user-supplied rate only. Output must carry 'informational estimate only, not tax advice; consult a tax professional.' Verified 2026-10-01: registry contains zero tax-rate constants.

variables.effectiveTaxRatePct: USER INPUT, 0-100, NEVER prefilled or defaulted
variables.quarterNetProfit: USER INPUT (optional; annual/4 used if absent)

formulas.formula: extraRevisions = max(0, requestedRevisions - includedRevisions); mode pct-of-fee: revisionFee = baseProjectFee * (revisionPct / 100) * extraRevisions; mode flat: revisionFee = flatPerRevision * extraRevisions; newProjectTotal = baseProjectFee + revisionFee.
formulas.name: Revision Pricing
formulas.notes: Revision pricing is the user's own policy.

formulas.formula: mode hourly: scopeCreepFee = additionalHours * hourlyRate; mode pct-of-fee: scopeCreepFee = originalFee * (creepPct / 100); revisedProjectTotal = originalFee + scopeCreepFee.
formulas.name: Scope Creep Fee
formulas.notes: Math only.

formulas.formula: for each milestone i: amount_i = contractValue * (pct_i / 100); constraint: SUM(pct_i) = 100 (validation error otherwise); remainder cents from rounding assigned to final milestone.
formulas.name: Milestone Payment Split
formulas.notes: Pure percentage-split math.

formulas.formula: royaltyPerUnit = listPrice * (royaltyRatePct / 100); grossRoyalties = royaltyPerUnit * expectedUnits; netAfterFees = grossRoyalties - (grossRoyalties * (platformFeePct / 100) + fixedFees).
formulas.name: eBook Royalty Estimate
formulas.notes: Royalty rates vary by retailer, format, territory, and price band, and change over time. No retailer-specific rates (e.g., 35%/70% style presets) are hardcoded or presented as facts.

formulas.formula: for each platform p: netPayout_p = salePrice * (1 - feePct_p / 100) - fixedFee_p; rank platforms by netPayout_p descending.
formulas.name: Platform Fee Net-Payout Comparison
formulas.notes: Platform fee schedules change; the tool must require user-entered fees and label them 'as entered by you — verify against current platform docs.'

variables.feePct_p: USER INPUT per platform, 0-100 — no hardcoded platform fees

formulas.formula: lineTotal_i = hours_i * rate_i; subtotal = SUM(lineTotal_i); taxAmount = subtotal * (taxRatePct / 100) [only if user entered a rate]; totalDue = subtotal + taxAmount. All money rounded to 2 decimals.
formulas.name: Billable-Hours Invoice Total
formulas.notes: No tax rate defaults. Absent tax rate means no tax line, not 0%.

formulas.formula: laborCost = estimatedHours * hourlyRate (user inputs); projectPrice = laborCost + extraCosts (user inputs); effectiveUnitRate = projectPrice / units (minutes, episodes, etc.).
formulas.name: Generic Project Price (labor + extras)
formulas.notes: Shared labor-plus-costs pattern reused across service pricing calculators.

formulas.formula: tierPrice = SUM(componentPrices_user) * (1 - bundleDiscountPct / 100); savingsVsALaCarte = SUM(componentPrices_user) - tierPrice.
formulas.name: Package Tier Pricing
formulas.notes: Shared tier/package pattern.

formulas.formula: totalHours = SUM(taskHours_i) (user estimates); workDays = totalHours / workHoursPerDay; calendarDays = workDays + bufferDays; endDate = startDate + calendarDays (date arithmetic).
formulas.name: Project Timeline Estimate
formulas.notes: Output labeled 'based on your estimates' — estimates are guesses, not measurements.

formulas.formula: laborCost = hoursWorked * hourlyCostRate; profit = revenue - laborCost - directExpenses; marginPct = (profit / revenue) * 100 (revenue > 0).
formulas.name: Client Profitability
formulas.notes: Internal cost rate is the user's own figure (not billable rate).

formulas.formula: requiredAnnualRevenue = annualIncomeGoal + annualExpenses; requiredMonthlyRevenue = requiredAnnualRevenue / 12; clientsNeededPerMonth = requiredMonthlyRevenue / avgClientValue; weeklyTarget = requiredAnnualRevenue / workWeeksPerYear.
formulas.name: Income Goal Plan
formulas.notes: Plan math on user aspirations; output must not read as an earnings promise.

formulas.formula: mode pct: payoutPerReferral = avgClientValue * (commissionPct / 100); mode flat: payoutPerReferral = flatBounty; quarterlyProgramCost = payoutPerReferral * expectedReferralsPerQuarter.
formulas.name: Referral Program Payout
formulas.notes: Commission terms are the user's own program policy.

formulas.formula: hourlyModelCost = hourlyRate * estimatedHoursPerMonth; retainerModelCost = retainerFee + max(0, estimatedHoursPerMonth - retainerIncludedHours) * overageHourlyRate; breakEvenHours solves hourlyRate * H = retainerFee (+ overage beyond included hours); cheaperOption = min(hourlyModelCost, retainerModelCost).
formulas.name: Retainer vs Hourly Comparison
formulas.notes: Deterministic cost-model comparison; the 'recommendation' is arithmetic cheaper-option, not business advice.

variables.overageHourlyRate: user input, >= 0 (defaults to hourlyRate with note if blank)

globalRule: All percentages, rates, multipliers, and fees in these formulas are USER INPUTS (user assumptions / user pricing policy). This registry contains NO factual claims about market rates, legal standards, tax rates, or platform fee schedules. Tools must never prefill, default, or present any rate as standard, typical, or legally required. Verified 2026-10-01: no rates hardcoded.
